title: Oxva Slim Stick Pink Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pods for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit deliver a sweet and tangy soda-inspired flavour in a convenient, ready-to-use format. Each pod is filled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing up to 600 puffs with a smooth mouth-to-lung draw. The flavour combines the fruity sweetness of mixed red berries with the sparkling tang of Lemonade, creating a lively vape that’s both sweet and refreshing. Built-in coils ensure steady vapour and flavour performance, while the closed design makes replacing pods quick and mess-free. Supplied in a pack of two, these pods are ideal for Slim Stick users looking for a bright, fruity vape with a fizzy twist.
